reasons.claim: Three taḥwīl branches meet at Shu'ba and the closing back-reference, which are shared by all three routes.
reasons.quote: قالوا جميعا حدثنا شعبة، بهذا الإسناد

reasons.claim: The gloss on Khalid and the comparison to another report are not links or routes.
reasons.quote: نحو حديث عثمان بن عمر بقصته

reasons.claim: Two branches meet at Yunus and share the tail written once after the second Yunus down to Ali.
reasons.quote: حدثنا يونس، عن الزهري، أخبرنا علي بن حسين، أن حسين بن علي  عليهم السلام  أخبره أن عليا قال

reasons.claim: Both branches lead to the shared tail written once after the second branch, so Urwa and Aisha belong in shared_tail rather than only in the second route.
reasons.quote: قال الزهري فأخبرني عروة، عن عائشة

reasons.claim: Ibn Abbas at the end is only commenting on a Quranic phrase and is not a link.

notes: Urwa and Aisha are written once after both branches and form the shared_tail; Ibn Shihab and al-Zuhri are kept as written in their respective groups.

reasons.claim: The single chain runs through five transmitters to Abu Ja'far al-Baqir, excluding the date phrase.
reasons.quote: عن منصور بن حازم، عن عبد الرحيم القصير، عن أبى جعفر الباقر

reasons.claim: Urwa asks Abdullah ibn Amr and Abdullah answers, so both are links in order and Abdullah is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن عروة بن الزبير، قال سألت عبد الله بن عمرو

reasons.claim: The chain runs through five transmitters to Abu Abd Allah Ja'far ibn Muhammad, who is named after the chain as the speaker.
reasons.quote: عن عمرو بن الاشعث قال: سمعت أبا عبد الله جعفر بن محمد يقول

reasons.claim: Two taḥwīl branches each write their own full chain down to Aisha with no shared tail.
reasons.quote: قال سمعت عائشة، ح وحدثنا مسدد

reasons.claim: The text names a separate transmitter Abd Allah between Abd Allah ibn Uthman and Shu'ba, which the stored chain preserves while the expanded routes omit it.
reasons.quote: حدثنا عبد الله بن عثمان، أخبرنا عبد الله، أخبرنا شعبة

reasons.claim: The stored chain contains all five links in order including the second Abd Allah.
The single chain runs from Malik ibn Isma'il to Jabir, excluding the identifying gloss on Abd al-Aziz and al-Zubayr who is only named in the saying.
reasons.quote: حدثنا مالك بن إسماعيل، حدثنا عبد العزيز  هو ابن أبي سلمة  عن محمد بن المنكدر، عن جابر

reasons.claim: The chain ends at the unnamed transmitter after Ibn Sirin, excluding the dashed gloss on Hushaym and al-Ala ibn al-Hadrami whose practice is only described.
reasons.quote: عن ابن سيرين، - قال أحمد قال مرة يعني هشيما - عن بعض ولد العلاء أن العلاء بن الحضرمي
